## Content standards

All nine task titles are clean, all have marked and verifiable `## Success Criteria`, and their `epic:artifact-archival` membership slug is valid kebab-case. No child is a story or epic requiring its own identifying membership label.

Blocking defect F1: `a9f8e04d` is not self-contained. Its description says each candidate carries “the same target plan envelope used by preview,” requiring the reader to recover the contract from sibling work. This violates the standalone-description rule in [jit-content-standards.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/reference/jit-content-standards.md:13) and its explicit sibling-reference prohibition at line 67. The offending text is in [a9f8e04d](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/.jit/issues/a9f8e04d-b6fc-4f2f-96be-bc751e6bc66b.json:4).

Concrete fix:

- Replace “each candidate carrying the same target plan envelope used by preview” with:

  > Each `candidates` element is a complete schema-version-1 artifact-plan envelope containing `schema_version`, `target`, `destination_root`, `eligible`, `policy_status`, `action_counts`, `count`, `artifacts`, `blockers`, and `warnings`. Each artifact preserves `source`, `version`, `content_identity`, `destination`, `action`, `already_archived`, `provenance`, `format`, `owners`, `edges`, `reference_changes`, `pending_deletions`, `evidence`, `blockers`, and `warnings`.

- Rewrite `REQ-05` as:

  > - [hard] REQ-05: JSON uses `{"schema_version":1,"count":N,"candidates":[...]}`; every candidate contains the complete schema-version-1 plan and artifact fields enumerated above and preserves its `configured`, `incomplete`, or `unconfigured` `policy_status`.

## Coverage vs. design

The nine design items all have corresponding issues; no active extra issue remains.

| Design item | Issue | Matches? |
|---|---|---|
| Artifact plan model and blocker taxonomy | `28fb4e6a` | Yes |
| Target root inventory and ownership | `b45ad545` | Yes |
| Recursive supported-dependency discovery | `971c67f4` | Yes |
| Move/copy/retain/block classification | `0c86d83b` | Yes |
| Storage-owned artifact mutation primitive | `67f4ded1` | Yes |
| Unified archive preview surface | `41aa6056` | Yes |
| Coordinated plan execution | `f205aa7e` | Yes |
| Remove the legacy document-archive command | `271dc224` | Yes |
| Read-only container candidate report | `a9f8e04d` | Partial: scope matches, but its prerequisite ordering does not |

The previously superseded `1e6fce38` and `b8281931` issues were archived, disconnected, and deleted. They now appear only in historical events.

## Dependency DAG correctness

The foundation chain, storage/execution join, and final legacy-removal join match the plan. There are no observed over-constraints.

Blocking defect F2: the candidate report has the wrong prerequisite. Design §3 says it depends on both classifier and preview ([plan line 522](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/dev/active/7d3a3a47-plan.md:522)); the rationale states it consumes “the `jit archive` command surface the preview task establishes” ([line 321](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/dev/active/7d3a3a47-plan.md:321)). However, [a9f8e04d dependencies](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/.jit/issues/a9f8e04d-b6fc-4f2f-96be-bc751e6bc66b.json:8) contain only classifier `0c86d83b`. It can therefore start before preview `41aa6056` creates the command family it must extend.

Concrete fix:

```bash
jit dep add a9f8e04d 41aa6056 --reduce
```

`--reduce` is required because `41aa6056` already depends on `0c86d83b`; it replaces the now-redundant direct classifier edge while preserving classifier reachability.

Blank-workspace reachability otherwise passes. The two implementation roots are `28fb4e6a` and `67f4ded1`; both add capabilities within the existing Rust workspace and require no sibling-created crate, directory, or project skeleton.

## Structural integrity

The flat task tier is justified in design §3 lines 314–326: group headings are deliberately organizational, all leaves are independently landable, and intermediate containers would distort dependency-derived hierarchy. The resolved hierarchy confirms all nine tasks are direct children of epic `7d3a3a47`, while planning `1dbc72f6` remains under breakdown `220cca3e`.

No active isolated, dangling, or wrongly nested issue was found. The integrated scope of `f205aa7e` is large but remains one coherent transactional executor and does not invalidate the stated flat-tier rationale.

## Prior review feedback

Both prior blocking findings were addressed:

- Planning issue `1dbc72f6` now records a passing `plan-review` from 2026-07-13 11:30 UTC.
- Superseded tasks `1e6fce38` and `b8281931` were removed from the live issue store and all dependency edges.

No prior blocking finding remains unresolved.

## Findings

1. **F1 — High, blocking:** Candidate-report issue `a9f8e04d` is not standalone because “the same target plan envelope used by preview” leaves its required schema defined only by sibling context. Apply the exact description and `REQ-05` rewrites above.
2. **F2 — High, blocking:** Candidate-report issue `a9f8e04d` can begin before prerequisite preview surface `41aa6056`, contrary to design §3. Run `jit dep add a9f8e04d 41aa6056 --reduce`.

Total findings: 2
